snippet.title: Drowned Lake - New Demo Trailer Convergence Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
When Bento, an amateur documentarian vanishes, three strangers are drawn to the Drowned Lake to find him. As the lake’s dark past comes to light, so do the secrets buried deep within them. Explore, survive, and investigate the dark waters in this fishing survival horror game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601540/Drowned_Lake/
